serverInfo.title: Agent Nexus
serverInfo.description: Registry of 700+ human-reviewed APIs, MCP servers and CLIs that AI agents can call, health-checked hourly for priority entries and otherwise on a rolling daily cycle, with endpoint, auth parameters, formats, rate limits and a 0-100 reliability score. Whole catalogue downloadable in one call at https://agentnexus.app/api/public/entries.ndjson; new interfaces feed at https://agentnexus.app/feed.xml.
